subject: Coverage reconciliation + attrition triage: Q3 forecast lock
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Julia Adams <julia.adams@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coverage reconciliation + attrition triage: Q3 forecast lock

Hi Julia,

We're doing a short coverage reconciliation ahead of our Q3 forecast lock and noticed Acme's usage profile is down ~18% month-over-month. To make sure Finance has an accurate commit for the quarter, can you confirm whether the 350k token/month commitment still holds for Oct–Dec, or if Procurement is re-scoping?

Quick asks:
- Confirm committed monthly tokens for Q4 (if changed, please indicate new number)
- Flag any lines of business evaluating pause/scale-down this quarter and expected decision date
- If Procurement needs an updated purchase order or revised SOW, please send a contact and timeline

I've attached a small snapshot of usage and the commit matrix we have in the forecast. If it'd help, we can hop on a 20-min call tomorrow morning to align.

Thanks —
Connor
Director, Renewals (Americas)
Redwood Inference
attachments: acme_commit_matrix.xlsx, prod_usage_snapshot.csv

From: Julia Adams <julia.adams@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-09-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage reconciliation + attrition triage: Q3 forecast lock

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the heads up. We're in the middle of a budget reshuffle in Product — trending usage is lower because two proof-of-concept projects wrapped in mid-September. Procurement is reviewing the renewal terms; at the moment, leadership is considering a 20% reduction to committed units starting Nov 1 if we don't get additional budget approvals.

Two notes:
- I'll confirm by Oct 4 whether leadership will reinstate the original commit or approve the reduced figure.
- Procurement asked for an updated cost table showing the impact of a 20% commitment reduction on per-token price and any minimums.

I'll attach a brief note from Finance (see reply_budget_note.pdf) — it's high level. Happy to take the call if you think it will speed alignment.

Best,
Julia
Head of ML Platforms, Acme Corp
attachments: reply_budget_note.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Coverage reconciliation + attrition triage: Q3 forecast lock

Team — forwarding Acme's reply. Key points for forecasting and next steps:

Summary: Acme may reduce committed units by ~20% starting Nov 1; set to confirm by Oct 4. Risk to Q4 ARR if they go through with the reduction.

Action items (please):
- Marissa: model a P&L projection for both scenarios (350k commit and 280k commit) and show SEV/ARR delta for Q4. Needed by EOD Oct 3.
- Naomi: mark Acme as "conditional at-risk" in the renewal tracker and move to "finance review" stage; set probability to 0.65 pending confirmation. Add a note linking to the procurement contact and Oct 4 decision date.
- Ben: prepare a pricing delta table (per-token and net ARR impact) and a short blurb we can share with Procurement to accelerate approval.
- Laura: hold the 20% reduction as a potential revenue haircut for consolidated forecast and flag any linked accounts in the same bucket.

I recommend we offer a one-time credit or pilot extension to preserve the larger commit if Procurement asks for flexibility — please advise on feasibility. I'm available for a sync tomorrow 8:30–9:30am PT if anyone wants to run through the numbers.

Thanks,
Connor

-----Original Message-----
From: Julia Adams <julia.adams@acme.com>
Sent: 2027-09-30 09:05

(see above)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Coverage reconciliation + attrition triage: Q3 forecast lock

Connor — quick update:

- Modeling complete (attached acme_commit_matrix.xlsx v2). If Acme drops to 280k tokens, net Q4 ARR impact is ~-$42.5k (recurring) and short-term cashflow down ~$31k for the quarter.
- I recommend we set probability to 0.6 while Procurement evaluates; used conservative churn assumptions for the calculations.
- Ben: I've pulled the pricing delta table and placed it in the shared Drive (link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/ACME-Pricing-Delta). If Procurement wants levers, we can propose a 90-day grace period at current pricing in exchange for a signed amendment.

I'll add notes to the renewal tracker and tag Naomi to update the stage.

Marissa
Senior Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: acme_commit_matrix.xlsx v2
